instruction: Change the title text color on slide 1 to red (#FF0000).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide 1 title text color to red (#FF0000), matching the color of slide 2's title. Verified from original file that slide 2 title is red RGB (255, 0, 0). Evaluator checks if slide 1 title color matches this RGB value with tolerance of 5.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: changing slide 1 title color to red (#FF0000)
Getter logic is sound: extracts PowerPoint file, identifies title as topmost text shape, and extracts RGB color from first run
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('target_color') without wrapping in 'rules' key
RGB comparison logic is correct with configurable tolerance (5), comparing each channel independently
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure updated state is captured
Edge cases handled: missing file, invalid slide index, no title shape, missing color data
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Title detection uses 'topmost text shape' heuristic which could fail if header/logo exists above title, though this is pragmatic given python-pptx limitations
Minor: Getter only checks first run's color; if title has mixed formatting, only first word is verified. For this task (entire title to red) this should be sufficient
